title: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS…
description: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability (CWE-78) that allows a low-privileged attacker to execute arbitrary code without user interaction. The vulnerability affects the context of the current user and changes the security scope. It has a critical severity with a CVSS score of 9.9.
